citation: Köhne (2005) · Mini suction cups and water extraction
material_or_protocol: Porous small/large ceramic cups in soil; varied saturation and vacuum.
intended_use: Apparent system uptake; reserve large saturated cup.
qualification: Effective cup and soil resistance; not intrinsic woody membrane permeability.

citation: Leuschner et al. (2003) · Periderm and in situ fine-root water absorption
material_or_protocol: Beech, oak, spruce; single stand, four dates.
intended_use: Species-specific field prior; hold out last date.
qualification: Dates or roots from one stand are not independent sites; group dispersion is SD.

citation: Cuneo et al. (2018) · Water uptake through woody grapevine roots
material_or_protocol: Intact and peeled grapevine root; prior hydration; hydrostatic uptake.
intended_use: Treatment-specific uptake inputs and an advancing-angle constraint.
qualification: Advancing bark angle ≠ receding angle; area basis differs from wetted area.

citation: Hueckel et al. (2022) · Dynamics and instabilities of Haines jumps
material_or_protocol: Three borosilicate cylinders; water; measured apparent angles.
intended_use: Two-site glass calibration with within-run checks.
qualification: No independent replicate from four contact sites; three-body force is not a two-body force.

citation: Liao et al. (2026) · Wetting morphology and capillary force between parallel cylinders
provenance: Consensus Pro + publisher; previously listed, not ingested
material_or_protocol: Parallel cylinders of varying diameters, gap, volume and wettability.
intended_use: Reserve measured force–gap series and bridge geometry.
qualification: The supplement mixes measurements, Surface Evolver and analytical curves. Total N ≠ N/m.

citation: Chen & Arye (2026) · Liquid and dried maize root mucilage
material_or_protocol: Dried maize mucilage coatings and liquid formulations on planar substrate.
intended_use: Conditional bounds for coated-substrate sensitivity.
qualification: Neither a receding bark angle nor a measured total water–air tension. Do not use as bare-root constants.

citation: Wang et al. (2016) · Capillary force and rupture of funicular liquid bridges
material_or_protocol: Multiple particles / connected liquid; boundary condition matters.
intended_use: Future topology and rupture test.
qualification: Separate experiment from simulated suction-controlled cases; match topology and protocol.

citation: Bokányi-Tóth et al. (2026) · Liquid bridges between horizontal cylinders
material_or_protocol: Horizontal rods; oils; morphology and dynamics.
intended_use: Geometry and relaxation comparator.
qualification: Not water or biological uptake; transient validation needs a dynamic solver.

citation: Baca Cabrera et al. (2024) · Root hydraulic properties database
provenance: Primary authors’ data release and linked repository
material_or_protocol: Many species; radial, axial and whole-root-system properties.
intended_use: Locate external hydrostatic radial measurements at original-study level.
qualification: Deduplicate by original study; filter tissue, area basis, driving force and units. Not independent evidence itself.

citation: Keyes et al. (2017) · Measurement of soil deformation around growing root tips
material_or_protocol: Intact and decapped maize; synchrotron CT with DVC and grain tracking.
intended_use: Soil displacement around growing roots.
qualification: Root growth moves tissue into the ROI; mask it. Not a suction field or woody pull-out.

citation: Anselmucci et al. (2021) · Root–soil microstructure interaction in sand
material_or_protocol: Maize in fine/coarse Hostun sand; public release covers loose preparations.
intended_use: Porosity versus distance; candidate grain/DVC replay.
qualification: Radial porosity extent is not the extent of displacement. Dense target is paper only in this release.

citation: Herrero-Huerta et al. (2022) · Black walnut root architecture in 4D
material_or_protocol: One black walnut seedling; three weekly scans.
intended_use: Prescribed tree geometry or held-out growth geometry.
qualification: Not independent plants; root-only surfaces cannot provide soil displacements.

citation: Iijima et al. (2003) · Root cap removal and maize penetration resistance
material_or_protocol: Intact vs decapped maize cv. Mephisto; loose/compacted soil; two experiments.
intended_use: Independent future growth-force benchmark; preserve both experiments.
qualification: Macroscopic penetration resistance = measured root force / estimated root area, not suction.

citation: McKenzie et al. (2013) · Root–soil friction from penetration and rotation
material_or_protocol: Growing pea roots and a slow rotating probe; adhesion assumptions varied.
intended_use: Prior for an effective root-tip interface, not a grain law.
qualification: 0.21 and 0.26 are alternative model estimates from the same data, not two replicates.

citation: Schwarz et al. (2011) · Pullout tests of root analogs and natural bundles
material_or_protocol: Wet/dry sand and silty soil; low confining loads.
intended_use: Macroscopic interface resistance bounds.
qualification: Confinement and moisture both change between quoted extrema. Values in kPa are not Coulomb coefficients.

citation: Bull et al. (2020) · Root reinforcement in 4D CT and DVC
material_or_protocol: Willow C under interrupted direct shear; noise controls.
intended_use: Physical DVC noise threshold and withheld displacement field.
qualification: Shares Willow C with Bull 2022. No growth between these load steps is assumed.

citation: Bull et al. (2022) · Stress transfer in root-reinforced soils
material_or_protocol: Bullionfield soil; willow, gorse, fallow and artificial roots.
intended_use: Specimen conditions, shear displacement histories, load and field comparators.
qualification: Top tensiometer is not the shear-plane suction field; water content calculated via retention curve.

citation: Tomobe et al. (2021) · Root–soil interface under changing suction
material_or_protocol: Separate suction-controlled and normal-stress-controlled interface tests.
intended_use: Reserve a suction series for validation after dry interface calibration.
qualification: Schedules are imposed conditions, not strength observations. Do not combine the separate series.

citation: Kamchoom, Leung & Ng (2014) · Root geometry, transpiration and pull-out
material_or_protocol: Centrifuge root analogues; different geometries and transpiration.
intended_use: Held-out full-root anchorage test.
qualification: Requires scale conversion, root architecture, and many-grain contact. Not a local capillary force.

citation: Ng et al. (2014) · Porous root system and transpiration-induced suction in centrifuge
material_or_protocol: Porous root surrogate under vacuum.
intended_use: Reserve suction magnitude and profile for analogue hydraulics.
qualification: Do not substitute analogue conductance for plant tissue or count related apparatus as independent without checking.

citation: Mickovski et al. (2007) · Stiffness, branching and matric potential in pull-out
material_or_protocol: Analogue materials; geometry and moisture effects; 2D imaging.
intended_use: Force–displacement / root-shape holdouts.
qualification: Treat any replot of the same experimental curve as one observation family.

citation: Meijer et al. (2019) · Coupled axial and lateral root deformation
material_or_protocol: Root analogues with different bending/axial stiffness; experiments and calculations.
intended_use: Select empirical curves only; root deformation and force.
qualification: Fig. 20 reproduces previously published data; do not count twice with Mickovski.

citation: Zhu et al. (2025) · Australian native species: root bundle pull-out
material_or_protocol: Field-scale tree and shrub roots; species / morphologies differ.
intended_use: Order-of-magnitude external check for full-tree module.
qualification: No comparison of whole-bundle N against a 2D grain force in N/m.

citation: Rüdinger et al. (1994) · Hydraulic and osmotic properties of spruce roots
material_or_protocol: Excised root systems of two-year-old Norway spruce seedlings.
intended_use: A hydrostatic transfer check and negative control for the osmotic protocol.
qualification: Different ages, areas and external soil resistances from mature in-situ spruce roots.

citation: Stretching and compressing capillary bridges on hydrophilic, hydrophobic, and liquid-infused surfaces (2026)
material_or_protocol: Parallel plates, 10 µL of 80 wt% glycerol in water, 20–23 °C.
intended_use: Secondary benchmark for geometry–force closure after matching the apparatus.
qualification: Use directly measured top force, not inferred bottom force. Not a pure-water or cylinder experiment.

citation: Rosskopf, Uteau & Peth (2025) · Deformation patterns around growing roots
material_or_protocol: Maize in sand/loam, genotype and root-diameter contrasts; day 0 vs day 6.
intended_use: Independent directional check on radial displacement and strain.
qualification: Data on reasonable request; published study is not a downloadable greyscale pair.

citation: Liévano, Velankar and McCarthy (2017), Powder Technology
material_or_protocol: Ethylene glycol between acrylic spheres
intended_use: Future 3D force comparison
qualification: Total force in µN. A 2D line force cannot be substituted.
